info.title: incrementalist
info.description: .NET Core global tool for determining how to run incremental builds based on the current Git diff.

commands.name: run
commands.description: Run a command against affected projects. Use the `--dry` option to test without executing.

options.name: --sln
options.description: The name of the Solution file to be analyzed by Incrementalist. Defaults to '*.sln' in the current directory.

options.name: --file
options.description: If specified, writes the output to the named file.

options.name: --branch
options.description: The git branch to compare against, i.e. 'dev' or 'master'.

options.name: --dir
options.description: Specify the working directory explicitly. Defaults to using the current working directory.

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Prints out extensive debug logs during operation. [default: False]

options.name: --timeout
options.description: Specifies the load timeout for the solution in whole minutes. Defaults to 2 minutes. [default: 2]

options.name: --config
options.description: Path to the configuration file. Defaults to .incrementalist/incrementalist.json in the current directory.

options.name: --continue-on-error
options.description: When running commands, continue executing even if some commands fail. [default: True]

options.name: --parallel
options.description: When running commands, execute them in parallel. [default: False]

options.name: --parallel-limit
options.description: When running commands, the number of parallel projects to run. [default: 0]

options.name: --fail-on-no-projects
options.description: When running commands, fail if no projects are affected. [default: False]

options.name: --skip-glob
options.description: Glob pattern to exclude projects from the final list. Applied after analyzing dependencies.

options.name: --target-glob
options.description: Glob pattern to include only matching projects in the final list. Applied after analyzing dependencies.

options.name: --name-application-to-start
options.description: The application or document to start the process. [default: dotnet]

options.name: --dry
options.description: Performs a dry run without executing any commands. Useful for testing.

options.name: --engine
options.description: The engine used to analyze the solutions and projects. Either StaticGraph or Workspace [default: 0]

options.name: --help
options.description: Display this help screen.

options.name: --version
options.description: Display version information.
